context_requirements: Expression of PRKCA (or the relevant PKC isoform) and an intact PKC->MAPK/AP-1 signalling module
Active proliferation for the antiproliferative/G2-M component
Wild-type TP53 for the apoptotic arm (mutant or null TP53 lines show weaker killing)
falsifiers: No change in FOS/EGR1/JUN or other AP-1/immediate-early transcripts at 6 h in any line
No reduction in proliferation or G2/M transcripts (CCNB1, CDK1, TOP2A) at 24 h in any line
Responses identical in PRKCA-high and PRKCA-low lines, indicating the effect is not on-target
No dose-dependent difference between 10 uM and lower concentrations

evidence.supports: PKC412, a staurosporine-derived protein kinase inhibitor, inhibits PKC and causes G2/M accumulation, polyploidy and apoptosis in tumour cells
A protein kinase (GSK3beta) inhibitor activates p53 and induces apoptosis in melanoma cells, showing kinase inhibitors can drive p53-dependent death
